scope: Selective opaque-pass multisample coverage and framebuffer resolve validation

shader_baseline.revision_provenance: Root identified this as the frozen shader revision used by these tests.
shader_baseline.hash_check_scope: The 60-frame 0x/4x before-and-after captures checked Get-FileHash(scene.frag) before and after the paired runs and reported equality. The complete hash value was not retained.
shader_baseline.integration_note: These tests precede the final room reflection probe and current lighting integration; root will verify that integration separately.

render_configuration.water_and_glass: Single-sample composition after opaque color/depth resolve
render_configuration.resolve: glBlitFramebuffer color plus depth, equal dimensions and formats, GL_NEAREST

paired_visual_comparison.detail_layout: Joint crop without MSAA, joint crop with 4x MSAA, radiator crop without MSAA, radiator crop with 4x MSAA; crops enlarged 2x with nearest-neighbor for inspection.
paired_visual_comparison.finding: The actual captures show substantially more continuous thin ceramic joints with 4x coverage. The radiator has fewer broken edge/highlight segments but still contains high-frequency metallic shading.
paired_visual_comparison.cause_assessment: Subpixel geometric coverage is the dominant demonstrated cause of the joint interruptions. The improvement occurs without changing geometry, texture filtering or the 24-bit depth format; this does not establish that every visible artifact has the same cause.
paired_visual_comparison.not_measured: No automated pixel-exact seam continuity score or temporal flicker metric was computed.

longer_static_runs.synchronization: Final glReadPixels capture occurs before the printed elapsed time, waiting for preceding rendering to complete.
longer_static_runs.sample_comparison_note: Uses the 0x/4x images from the paired visual comparison and the 2x image from the 600-frame run; camera, dimensions and simulation time are identical.
longer_static_runs.decision: Retain 4x as the default because 2x leaves visible seam interruptions. The 0x/2x options remain available for performance tuning.

atrium_static_run.inspection: Actual capture was inspected: water, reflected architecture, foliage and transparent elements remain visible after depth/color resolve.
atrium_static_run.limitation: This checks the static scene integration and visible composition; it is not an exhaustive transparent-edge or refraction correctness test.

resize_and_scene_cycle.timing_note: This run did not request a final screenshot or explicit GPU synchronization. The reported elapsed time must not be interpreted as completed-frame throughput.
resize_and_scene_cycle.result: PASS for runtime scene switching, resize path and collected GL error status

limitations: All timing runs used hidden windows with vsync disabled; none proves fullscreen FPS, interactive input latency or performance on another machine.
These are whole-run CPU wall-clock timings with a final readback where specified, not isolated GPU timer-query measurements.
The static runs use a fixed camera and simulation time and do not measure the worst case throughout either environment.
MSAA resolves geometric coverage; it does not fully solve specular shading aliasing, texture detail aliasing or transparent geometry edges.
The new room probe sampler and final material/lighting changes are outside this report's executed runtime coverage.
